_comment: Google A2A v0.3.0 Agent Card (https://a2a-protocol.org). Served by picoclaw at GET /.well-known/agent.json. NOTE: `url`, `protocolVersion` and `preferredTransport` are injected at runtime by picoclaw (ApplyRuntime) — values here are placeholders/hints. Operator-authored fields: `name`, `description`, `version`, `skills` (and optionally provider/capabilities/auth).
name: PicoClaw Agent
description: Describe what this agent can do for other A2A agents. Used by A2A clients for routing.

skills.name: Ask
skills.description: Send a natural-language question to this agent and receive an answer.
